unitTitle: Plurals - Countable/Uncountable Nouns - How Much/How Many - A Few/A Little - Some/Any

exercises.explanationUz:
KO'PLIK YASASHNING TO'RT QOIDASI:

  1) -F yoki -FE bilan tugasa → -VES
       loaf - loaVES,  knife - kniVES
     LEKIN ISTISNOLAR: cliff - cliffS,  roof - roofS

  2) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa → -IES
       cherry - cherrIES,  lady - ladIES

  3) UNLI + Y bilan tugasa → -S
       boy - boyS,  toy - toyS

  4) -O bilan tugasa → -ES
       tomato - tomatoES,  potato - potatoES
     LEKIN ISTISNOLAR: radio - radioS,  photo - photoS

DIQQAT — 2 va 3-QOIDANI FARQLASH:
  'y' dan OLDINGI harfga qarang:
     cherRY  — 'r' UNDOSH → cherrIES
     boY     — 'o' UNLI   → boyS

ISTISNOLARNI YOD OLING:
  -f/-fe lekin -S: cliff, roof, chief, belief
  -o lekin -S:     radio, photo, piano, video

points.en: Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f or -fe and take -ves to form their plural. — loaf - loaves, knife - knives
points.uz: -f yoki -fe bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -f/-fe ni tashlab, ko'plik yasash uchun -ves oladi. — non - nonlar, pichoq - pichoqlar
points.noteUz: Boshqa misollar: leaf - leaves, wife - wives, life - lives, shelf - shelves.

ISTISNOLAR — bu otlar oddiy -S oladi.
Yana: chief - chiefs, belief - beliefs.

points.en: Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take -ies. — cherry - cherries, lady - ladies
points.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan otlar -y ni tashlab -ies oladi. — gilos - giloslar, xonim - xonimlar
points.noteUz:
'y' dan OLDINGI harf UNDOSH bo'lishi kerak.
Yana: baby - babies, city - cities, story - stories.

points.en: Nouns ending in a vowel + y, take -s. — boy - boys, toy - toys
points.uz: Unli + y bilan tugagan otlar -s oladi. — bola - bolalar, o'yinchoq - o'yinchoqlar
points.noteUz:
'y' dan oldin UNLI (a, e, i, o, u) bo'lsa, y O'ZGARMAYDI.
Yana: day - days, key - keys, monkey - monkeys.

points.en: Some nouns ending in -o take -es. — tomato - tomatoes, potato - potatoes
points.uz: -o bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -es oladi. — pomidor - pomidorlar, kartoshka - kartoshkalar

points.noteUz:
ISTISNOLAR — bu otlar oddiy -S oladi.
Yana: piano - pianos, video - videos, kilo - kilos.

exercises.instructionEn: Countable / Uncountable Nouns and phrases of quantity.
exercises.instructionUz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar hamda miqdor iboralari.
exercises.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN OTLAR (Countable):
  • sanash mumkin: one lemon, two lemons, three lemons
  • BIRLIK va KO'PLIK shakli bor
  • BIRLIKDA: a/an bilan → a cherry, an orange
  • KO'PLIKDA: some bilan → some cherries, some oranges

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR (Uncountable):
  • sanab bo'lmaydi
  • faqat BIRLIK shakli bor
  • 'breads', 'butters' — XATO
  • some bilan → some bread, some butter
  • a/an bilan ISHLATILMAYDI

MIQDOR IBORALARI (phrases of quantity):
  slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet
  + OF + ot
     a bottle OF water
     a kilo OF apples

Bu iboralar SANALADIGAN otlar bilan ham,
SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan ham ishlatiladi.

points.en: Countable nouns are those nouns which we can count. They have singular and plural forms. — one lemon, two lemons, three lemons
points.uz: Sanaladigan otlar — sanash mumkin bo'lganlari. Ularning birlik va ko'plik shakli bor. — bitta limon, ikkita limon, uchta limon

points.en: We use a/an with countable nouns in the singular. — a cherry, an orange
points.uz: Sanaladigan otning birligi bilan a/an ishlatamiz. — bitta gilos, bitta apelsin
points.noteUz: 'an' — UNLI TOVUSH bilan boshlanadigan so'z oldida: an orange, an apple, an egg.

points.en: We use some with countable nouns in the plural. — some cherries, some oranges
points.uz: Sanaladigan otning ko'pligi bilan some ishlatamiz. — bir nechta gilos, bir nechta apelsin

points.en: Uncountable nouns are those nouns which we cannot count. They have only singular forms. — bread, butter (NOT: breads, butters)
points.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar — sanab bo'lmaydiganlari. Ularning faqat birlik shakli bor. — non, sariyog' ('breads', 'butters' EMAS)

points.en: We can use some with uncountable nouns. — some bread, some butter
points.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan some ishlatishimiz mumkin. — bir oz non, bir oz sariyog'

points.en: We can use countable and uncountable nouns in phrases of quantity such as: slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet + of. — a bottle of water, a kilo of apples
points.uz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni miqdor iboralaridan keyin ishlatishimiz mumkin: slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet + of. — bir shisha suv, bir kilo olma
points.noteUz:
'OF' HECH QACHON TUSHIB QOLMAYDI.
'a bottle water' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any.
exercises.instructionUz: How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any.
exercises.explanationUz:
HOW MUCH / HOW MANY:
  how MUCH → SANALMAYDIGAN
     How much bread do you want?
  how MANY → SANALADIGAN
     How many potatoes do you want?

A FEW / A LITTLE:
  a FEW (= not many; some) → SANALADIGAN
     I want a few biscuits.
  a LITTLE (= not much; some) → SANALMAYDIGAN
     I want a little milk.

SOME / ANY:
  SOME → TASDIQ gapda
           sanaladigan KO'PLIK: some biscuits
           sanalmaydigan:       some milk
       → SAVOLDA, agar TAKLIF (offer) yoki ILTIMOS (request):
           Would you like some biscuits?   (offer)
           Can I have some water, please?  (request)

  ANY  → INKOR gapda
           I haven't got any strawberries.
       → oddiy SAVOLDA (ma'lumot so'rash)
           Have you got any milk?

ESLAB QOLISH USULI:
  MANY va FEW — SANALADIGAN
  MUCH va LITTLE — SANALMAYDIGAN
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 34-bet, nazariya (How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any)

points.en: We use how much with uncountable nouns. — How much bread do you want?
points.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan how much ishlatamiz. — Sizga qancha non kerak?
points.noteUz: 'how much' narx so'rash uchun ham: 'How much is it?'

points.en: We use how many with countable nouns. — How many potatoes do you want?
points.uz: Sanaladigan otlar bilan how many ishlatamiz. — Sizga nechta kartoshka kerak?
points.noteUz: 'how many' dan keyin ot DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

points.en: We use a few (= not many; some) with countable nouns. — I want a few biscuits.
points.uz: Sanaladigan otlar bilan a few (= ko'p emas; bir nechta) ishlatamiz. — Menga bir nechta pechenye kerak.
points.noteUz:
'a few' = bir nechta (ijobiy ma'no).
DIQQAT: 'few' (a-siz) = juda kam (salbiy ma'no).

points.en: We use a little (= not much; some) with uncountable nouns. — I want a little milk.
points.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a little (= ko'p emas; bir oz) ishlatamiz. — Menga bir oz sut kerak.
points.noteUz:
'a little' = bir oz (ijobiy ma'no).
DIQQAT: 'little' (a-siz) = juda oz (salbiy ma'no).

points.en: We use some in the affirmative with countable nouns in the plural and uncountable nouns. — I want some biscuits and some milk.
points.uz: Tasdiq gapda sanaladigan otning ko'pligi va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan some ishlatamiz. — Menga bir nechta pechenye va bir oz sut kerak.

points.en: We use some in the interrogative form for offers or requests. — Would you like some biscuits? (offer) Can I have some water, please? (request)
points.uz: So'roq shaklda taklif yoki iltimos uchun some ishlatamiz. — Pechenye xohlaysizmi? (taklif) Suv olsam bo'ladimi? (iltimos)
points.noteUz:
an offer = taklif (siz beryapsiz)
a request = iltimos (siz so'rayapsiz)

points.en: We use any in the negative and interrogative form. — I haven't got any strawberries. Have you got any milk?
points.uz: Inkor va so'roq shaklda any ishlatamiz. — Menda qulupnay yo'q. Sizda sut bormi?
points.noteUz:
INKOR: haven't got ANY
MA'LUMOT SO'RASH: Have you got ANY ...?

exercises.instructionEn: Write the plural forms of the words below.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR SO'Z UCHUN AVVAL OXIRGI HARFLARGA QARANG:
  -f / -fe  → -VES  (istisnolar bor!)
  undosh + y → -IES
  unli + y   → -S
  -o         → -ES  (istisnolar bor!)
  qolganlari → -S

items.whyUz: 2-qoida: undosh ('r') + y → -IES = cherrIES.

ISTISNO! -f bilan tugasa ham -VES OLMAYDI → cliffS.
Nazariya qutisida ham aynan shu misol berilgan.
'a cliff' = qoya, jarlik.

2-qoida: undosh ('l') + y → -IES = butterflIES.
'a butterfly' = kapalak (6-unitda ham bor edi).
4-qoida: -o → -ES = tomatoES.

ISTISNO! -o bilan tugasa ham -ES OLMAYDI → radioS.
Nazariya qutisida ham aynan shu misol berilgan.
Unli bilan tugaydi (lekin -o emas) → oddiy -S = bananaS.

3-qoida: UNLI ('o') + y → -S = toyS.
'toies' XATO.

1-qoida: -f → -VES = loaVES.
2-band bilan solishtiring: 'cliff' istisno, 'loaf' esa qoidaga bo'ysunadi.

ISTISNO! → photoS.
4-band bilan solishtiring: 'tomato' → tomatoES, 'photo' → photoS.

2-qoida: undosh ('t') + y → -IES = citIES.
'a city' = shahar.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  I'd like A water, please.  →  SOME
     ('a' chizib tashlangan, 'some' yozilgan)

XATO TURLARI:

  1) SANALMAYDIGAN otga 'a/an' qo'yilgan
       a water → SOME water
       a soup → SOME soup
       a salt → ANY salt

  2) HOW MUCH / HOW MANY noto'g'ri
       How many butter → How MUCH
       How much eggs → How MANY

  3) SANALMAYDIGAN otga -S qo'shilgan
       some hams → some HAM
       some cheeses → some CHEESE

  4) SOME / ANY noto'g'ri
       Would you like ANY coffee? → SOME (taklif)
       Can I have ANY milk? → SOME (iltimos)
       I haven't got SOME biscuits. → ANY (inkor)

  5) A FEW / A LITTLE noto'g'ri
       a little carrots → A FEW (sanaladigan)

  6) Ko'plik imlosi noto'g'ri
       cherrys → CHERRIES

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: 'a' → 'some'.
'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like SOME water, please.

items.textEn: 2  How many butter is there in the fridge? → ............
items.whyUz:
'butter' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Fe'l 'IS' ham buni tasdiqlaydi (ko'plik bo'lsa 'are' bo'lardi).

items.textEn: 3  I'm hungry. I'd like a soup. → ............
items.whyUz:
'soup' — SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like SOME soup.
(Restoranda 'a soup' = 'bir kosa sho'rva' ma'nosida ham eshitiladi,
lekin bu darslikning qoidasi bo'yicha SOME.)

items.textEn: 4  How much eggs do we need? → ............
items.whyUz: 'eggs' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

'salt' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
Bu MA'LUMOT so'rash savoli → ANY.
To'g'ri gap: Do we have ANY salt?

items.textEn: 6  How many sugar would you like? → ............
items.whyUz: 'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

items.textEn: 7  How much lemons do you need? → ............
items.whyUz:
'lemons' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.
Nazariya qutisida ham 'lemon' sanaladigan ot misoli sifatida berilgan.

'ham' — SANALMAYDIGAN → -S QO'ShILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like some HAM, please.

'Would you like ...?' — TAKLIF (offer) → SOME.
To'g'ri gap: Would you like SOME coffee?

items.textEn: 10  How many meat do you need? → ............
items.whyUz: 'meat' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

items.textEn: 11  Could I have a bananas, please? → ............
items.whyUz:
'a' + KO'PLIK ot — XATO.
Bu ILTIMOS savoli → SOME bananas.
To'g'ri gap: Could I have SOME bananas, please?
DIQQAT: 'a banana' (birlik) ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lardi,
lekin bu mashq some/any qoidasini mashq qildiradi.

'carrots' — SANALADIGAN → A FEW.
'a little' faqat sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.
To'g'ri gap: I need A FEW carrots.

items.textEn: 13  There are a few cherrys in the bowl. → ............
items.whyUz:
IMLO XATOSI: 'cherry' — undosh ('r') + y → -IES.
To'g'ri: CHERRIES.
1-mashqning 1-bandida ham shu so'z bor edi.

INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi.
To'g'ri gap: I haven't got ANY biscuits.
Nazariya qutisida ham aynan shu misol bor.

'Can I have ...?' — ILTIMOS (request) → SOME.
To'g'ri gap: Can I have SOME milk?
9-band bilan solishtiring: u TAKLIF, bu ILTIMOS — ikkalasida ham SOME.

'cheese' — SANALMAYDIGAN → -S QO'ShILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: I want some CHEESE.
8-band bilan bir xil xato turi.

groups.explanationUz: Ovqat otlari odatda -es, texnika otlari -s oladi.
Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar uchun turli so'zlar.

items.derived: how many, a few, a/an, some

groups.explanationUz: Gap turi va maqsadiga qarab tanlanadi.

patterns.formula: A/AN + sanaladigan BIRLIK  /  SOME + sanaladigan KO'PLIK yoki sanalmaydigan.
patterns.exampleEn: a cherry, an orange / some cherries, some bread
patterns.exampleUz: bitta gilos, bitta apelsin / bir nechta gilos, bir oz non

patterns.formula: How MUCH + sanalmaydigan?  /  How MANY + sanaladigan (ko'plik)?
patterns.exampleEn: How much bread do you want? How many potatoes do you want?
patterns.exampleUz: Sizga qancha non kerak? Sizga nechta kartoshka kerak?

patterns.formula: a FEW + sanaladigan  /  a LITTLE + sanalmaydigan.
patterns.exampleEn: I want a few biscuits. I want a little milk.
patterns.exampleUz: Menga bir nechta pechenye kerak. Menga bir oz sut kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
FEW — sanaladigan;  LITTLE — sanalmaydigan.
MANY-FEW va MUCH-LITTLE juftliklarini birga eslang.

patterns.exampleEn: a bottle of water, a kilo of apples
patterns.exampleUz: bir shisha suv, bir kilo olma
patterns.explanationUz: 'OF' shart. Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ham ishlaydi.

patterns.formula: SOME (tasdiq, taklif, iltimos)  /  ANY (inkor, ma'lumot savoli).
patterns.exampleEn: I want some milk. Would you like some tea? / I haven't got any milk. Have you got any milk?
patterns.exampleUz: Menga sut kerak. Choy xohlaysizmi? / Menda sut yo'q. Sizda sut bormi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Savol TAKLIF yoki ILTIMOS bo'lsa — SOME.
Oddiy ma'lumot so'rash bo'lsa — ANY.
